definitions.gloss: conclusion; final touch; wrapping up; summing up
definitions.explanation: The final part or finishing touch of something — a speech, event, project, or year. Emphasizes bringing things to a proper close.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一年|いちねん}→一年：10994_ichinen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{締|し}めくくり⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{忘年会|ぼうねんかい}→忘年会：15800_bounenkai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: We hold a year-end party as a way to wrap up the year.

examples.japanese: ⟦スピーチ→スピーチ：03852_supiichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{締|し}めくくり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}→感謝：00181_kansha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べた→述べる：02389_noberu⟧。
examples.english: I expressed words of gratitude to conclude my speech.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今|こん}→今〜：03952_kon⟧⟦シーズン→シーズン：10944_shiizun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{締|し}めくくり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ふさわしい⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧だった。
examples.english: It was a fitting game to wrap up this season.

notes:
From the verb {締|し}めくくる (to conclude, to wrap up). The noun form refers to the conclusion or final part of something, with an emphasis on bringing it to a satisfying or proper end.

USAGE:
Often used with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ or ⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧ to express 'as the conclusion of.' Very common at the end of the year (⟦{一年|いちねん}→一年：10994_ichinen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{締|し}めくくり), at the end of events, or when finishing projects.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{一年|いちねん}→一年：10994_ichinen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{締|し}めくくり: wrapping up the year
- ⟦シーズン→シーズン：10944_shiizun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{締|し}めくくり: conclusion of the season
- {締|し}めくくり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧: closing remarks
- {締|し}めくくり⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧: as a conclusion

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{結|むす}び→結び：02430_musubi⟧: conclusion, closing — more literary, often used for the end of essays or books
- ⟦{仕上|しあ}げ→仕上げ：11519_shiage⟧: finishing touch — emphasizes the final polish or completion of work
- ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧: the end, the last — neutral, simply refers to the final point without the nuance of 'wrapping up'
